summary: A silent, music-driven overhead cooking demo that builds a tortilla wrap step by step through close-up b-roll, relying entirely on visuals, on-screen text, and rising motion/energy to carry pacing rather than narration. The structure is a single continuous b-roll segment with sporadic cut clusters timed to key assembly moments and a late CTA push near the end.

'like' overlay appears, cheese and toppings added
Final wrap shown, motion spikes, subscribe CTA at 52s

recommendations.title: Add a text hook in the opening 3 seconds
recommendations.observation: hook_text_overlay is 0 and no overlay appears until 8.8s ('like'), so the first thing viewers read is a CTA rather than what's being made.
recommendations.recommendation: Test placing a short title-style text overlay (e.g. naming the dish) within the first 3 seconds, before the 'like' prompt, so viewers know the payoff they're building toward.

recommendations.title: Move the 'like' CTA later or soften its early placement
recommendations.observation: first_cta_pos is 0.136 (12th pct in category), meaning the like prompt lands very early, before the full wrap concept is shown.

evidence.value: text overlay 'like' shown over partially assembled wrap

recommendations.recommendation: Consider testing a delayed first CTA, after more of the build is visible, so the ask follows demonstrated value rather than preceding it.

recommendations.title: Address flat pacing in the middle section (30-45s)
recommendations.observation: Bins from 30-45s show zero cuts and declining motion (0.067, 0.077) compared to surrounding sections, creating a lull between two more dynamic stretches.
recommendations.recommendation: Test trimming or adding a cutaway/close-up cut within the 30-45s stretch to keep visual rhythm consistent with the rest of the video's pacing.

recommendations.title: Consider a brief verbal or captioned step-by-step guide
recommendations.observation: wpm and speech_coverage are both 0.0 (8th percentile), so the entire recipe relies on visuals alone with no spoken or captioned instructions for quantities or steps.
recommendations.recommendation: Test adding brief ingredient/step captions at key moments (e.g. when cheese, patty are added) so viewers can replicate the recipe without guessing quantities.

recommendations.title: Vary shot length to reduce abrupt pacing swings
recommendations.observation: shot_len_cv is 1.09, sitting at the 92nd percentile in category, indicating unusually high variability in shot lengths compared to peers.
recommendations.recommendation: Test smoothing transitions between very short and very long shots so the cut rhythm feels less uneven across the runtime.
